remarks: Private corner unit with park like views of the Courtyard has space and flexibility. This inviting three bedroom co-op features one floor living with the convenience of being in town. The generous, light-filled living room flows seamlessly into the adjacent dining area. The updated eat-in kitchen opens to a private patio, perfect for entertaining and relaxing. The primary suite features multiple closets, complemented by two additional bedrooms, and full bath. Hardwood floors add warmth and elegance throughout, off street parking with rental garage parking available. Located in central Greenwich, this unit is close to shopping, dining and the train, offering the perfect blend of comfort and convenience.

facts.laundryLoc: Can hook up in unit or common laundry
